message.content:
This editorial illustration features two caricatured figures looking at a mobile tablet. The figure on the right is seen in profile with a wide, pink-lipped smile, pointing a finger at a screen held by hands entering from the bottom left. The second figure, positioned centrally behind the tablet, has a pensive expression, touching their chin with one hand.

The tablet displays an interface titled "kader" with a portrait of a third man in front of a red and white flag, captioned "Ganjar, 54." Below the portrait are circular icons: a yellow arrow, a red "X," a green heart, and a blue map pin.

The background is a solid red. Above the figures, the word "TEMPO" appears in large, translucent grey serif lettering. Additional text includes "KAWAN DALAM SELIMUT" in bold white. Smaller white text below reads: "Presiden Jokowi berencana menduetkan Ganjar Pranowo dengan Prabowo Subianto. Tidak menutup opsi penundaan Pemilu 2024. H.24." Top headlines mention "Pilih-pilih Pidana Penjahat Pajak H.60" and "Salah Urus Impor Kereta Bekas H.70." A barcode and publication details for "20-26 MARET 2023" are in the bottom left corner.
